script: const getAudioPath = async(text,rate,outputDir,config)=>{const path = require("path");const fs = require("fs");const filename = new Date().getTime()+ ".wav";const outputPath = path.join(outputDir,"tts");if(!fs.existsSync(outputPath)){fs.mkdirSync(outputPath,{recursive: true})}try{const audioData = await getTTSAudio(text,rate,config);const filePath = path.join(outputPath,filename);fs.writeFileSync(filePath,audioData);return filePath}catch(error){console.error("生成音频失败:",error);throw error}};const mapSpeedToRate = (koodoSpeed)=>{if(isNaN(koodoSpeed)|| koodoSpeed===null|| koodoSpeed===undefined){console.warn("Koodo 速度参数无效，使用默认值 0");return 1.0}const mappedRate = 1.0 + (koodoSpeed / 100);const finalRate = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(2.0, mappedRate));if(finalRate !== mappedRate){console.log(`速度参数调整: Koodo=${koodoSpeed} -> Azure=${mappedRate.toFixed(2)} -> 最终=${finalRate.toFixed(2)}`)}else{console.log(`速度参数映射: Koodo=${koodoSpeed} -> Azure=${finalRate.toFixed(2)}`)}return finalRate};const objectToQueryString =(obj)=>{const params = [];for(const key in obj){if(obj.hasOwnProperty(key)){const value = obj[key];const encodedKey = encodeURIComponent(key);const encodedValue = encodeURIComponent(value);params.push(`${encodedKey}=${encodedValue}`)}}return params.join("&")};const getTTSAudio = async(text,rate,config)=>{const axios = require("axios");const url = "http://127.0.0.1:5003/api/tts";const voice = config.voice;const token = config.token;const azureRate = mapSpeedToRate(rate);const params ={text: text,voice: voice,e: azureRate.toFixed(2),token: token};const queryString = objectToQueryString(params);const fullUrl = `${url}?${queryString}`;console.log(`TTS 请求: 文本="${text}", 语音="${voice}", 原始速度=${rate}, Azure 语速=${azureRate.toFixed(2)}`);return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{axios.get(fullUrl,{responseType: "arraybuffer",timeout: 30000}).then(response =>{console.log("Azure TTS 请求成功");resolve(response.data)}).catch(error =>{console.error("Azure TTS 请求失败:",error.message);let errorMessage = "音频生成失败";if(error.response){errorMessage = `服务器错误: ${error.response.status}`;if(error.response.data){try{const errorText = Buffer.from(error.response.data).toString('utf8');errorMessage += ` - ${errorText}`}catch(e){}}}else if(error.request){errorMessage = "网络连接失败"}else{errorMessage = error.message}console.error(errorMessage);reject(new Error(errorMessage))})})};global.getAudioPath = getAudioPath;
